"""Shared, source-bound V195 preparation and resource helpers; no Torch import."""

import ast
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live, read, ref

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
BASE = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261108"
CPU = BASE / "V195-directional-response-CPU-v1"
ADMISSION = BASE / "V195-directional-response-admission-v1"
TRIAL = BASE / "V195-directional-response-trial-v1"
MODES = ("whole", "directional")


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def factory(config):
    from demosaic.late_pooled_phase_wave import LatePooledPhaseWaveDetail

    return LatePooledPhaseWaveDetail(**config)


def dependency():
    index = REPO / "docs/results/v187-pooled-wave-final-v1.json"
    proof = REPO / "docs/results/v187-pooled-wave-publication-verification-v1.json"
    final, verified = read(index), read(proof)
    assert final["status"].startswith("completed-")
    assert verified["status"].startswith("pass-") and verified["publication"] == ref(index)
    donor = final["checkpoints"]["V187-pooled-wave-EMA"]
    old = Path(final["plan"]["path"]).parent
    for name, result in [("wave-train", "wave-train-result-v1.json"), ("review", "scores-v1.json")]:
        assert not owner_live(read(old / f"{name}-launch-v1.json")["owner"])
        assert read(old / result)["status"].startswith("completed-")
    for binding in [donor["export"], donor["frozen_V183_initializer"]["export"]]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    cpu_result = read(CPU / "result-v2.json")
    assert cpu_result["status"].startswith("pass-V195-CPU-native-directional-loss")
    assert cpu_result["output_gradient_coordinates"] == 53477376
    assert "26 passed" in (CPU / "CPU-tests-v2.log").read_text()
    neural = read(REPO / "docs/results/v193-completed-execution-v1.json")[
        "previous103_neural_hashes_unchanged"
    ]
    assert len(neural) == 103
    for name, digest in neural.items():
        assert ref(REPO / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"] == digest
    return {
        "publication": ref(index),
        "verification": ref(proof),
        "donor": donor,
        "initializer": donor["frozen_V183_initializer"],
        "CPU_result": ref(CPU / "result-v2.json"),
        "CPU_tests": ref(CPU / "CPU-tests-v2.log"),
        "neural103": neural,
        "V187_plan": final["plan"],
    }


def freeze(root, entries):
    """Snapshot only code and its local import closure, never data or artifacts."""
    work = root / "work"
    shutil.copytree(
        REPO / "src", work / "src", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc")
    )
    pending = list(entries)
    copied = set()
    while pending:
        name = pending.pop()
        if name in copied:
            continue
        source = REPO / "scripts" / name
        target = work / "scripts" / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        copied.add(name)
        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text())):
            names = []
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                names = [alias.name for alias in node.names]
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and not node.level and node.module:
                names = [node.module]
            for imported in names:
                candidate = imported.split(".")[0] + ".py"
                if (REPO / "scripts" / candidate).is_file():
                    pending.append(candidate)
    return work, {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.rglob("*.py")}


def guard(plan, entry=None):
    if entry is not None:
        assert ref(entry) == plan["runner"], "Execute the sealed runner"
    for binding in plan["inputs"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    for name, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert ref(name)["sha256"] == digest


def resources(plan):
    available = {"local": shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free, "RAM": psutil.virtual_memory().available}
    for key, floor in plan["minimum_GiB"].items():
        assert available[key] > floor * 2**30, (key, available[key], floor)


def launch(root, phase, *, mode=None):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] * 2**30
    resources(plan)
    name = mode or phase
    assert not (root / f"{name}-launch-v1.json").exists()
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
        MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
        CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
    )
    command = [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), plan["runner"]["path"], phase]
    if mode:
        command += ["--mode", mode]
    with (root / f"{name}-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command, cwd=REPO, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True
        )
    owner = {"pid": process.pid, "created": psutil.Process(process.pid).create_time()}
    save(root / f"{name}-launch-v1.json", {"owner": owner, "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json")})
    return owner


def require_launch(root, name):
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    for _ in range(60):
        try:
            assert read(root / f"{name}-launch-v1.json")["owner"] == owner
            return owner
        except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            time.sleep(0.2)
    raise RuntimeError("Missing matching launch owner; CUDA not initialized")


def runtime(plan):
    from train_coherent_pair_evidence_engine import runtime as existing_runtime

    existing_runtime(plan)


def objective_total(terms, weight):
    import numpy as np
    from audit_coherent_pair_evidence_trial import loss_from_terms

    base = loss_from_terms({k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "response_addition"}, weight)
    return float(
        np.float32(
            np.float32(base) + np.float32(0.25 * weight) * np.float32(terms["response_addition"])
        )
    )

admit_directional_response.py.text:
"""V195: shared V187 EMA parity and restored head probes for both loss modes."""

import argparse
import copy
import gc
import time

from directional_trial_protocol import (
    ADMISSION as ROOT,
)
from directional_trial_protocol import (
    MODES,
    REPO,
    dependency,
    factory,
    freeze,
    guard,
    launch,
    objective_total,
    read,
    ref,
    require_launch,
    resources,
    runtime,
    save,
)


def prepare():
    dep = dependency()
    old = read(REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V187-pooled-wave-admission-v1/plan-v1.json")
    assert not ROOT.exists()
    ROOT.mkdir()
    (ROOT / "artifacts").mkdir()
    work, sources = freeze(
        ROOT, ["admit_directional_response.py", "inspect_directional_admission.py"]
    )
    plan = {
        "status": "prepared-shared-V187-EMA-parity-and-four-restored-loss-probes-not-quality",
        "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "work": str(work),
        "runner": ref(work / "scripts/admit_directional_response.py"),
        "donor": dep["donor"],
        "initializer": dep["initializer"],
        "dependency": dep,
        "module_config": dep["donor"]["module_config"],
        "cases": old["cases"],
        "sampling_library": old["sampling_library"],
        "pair_units": old["pair_units"],
        "domain_weights": old["domain_weights"],
        "probe_domains": ["mesh", "mixed"],
        "modes": list(MODES),
        "lr": 0.001,
        "weight_decay": 0.01,
        "minimum_GiB": {"local": 40, "RAM": 32},
        "launch_RAM_GiB": 52,
        "CUDA_quota_GiB": 24,
        "local_forecast_GiB": 0.05,
        "gradient_tolerance": {"rtol": 5e-5, "atol": 2e-5},
        "response_gradient_tolerance": {"rtol": 1e-5, "atol": 2e-8},
        "readout_tolerance": {"rtol": 1e-5, "atol": 3e-6},
        "scope": "Same completed V187 EMA full state,508 head parameters/four tensors;189 inherited V183 EMA tensors frozen and all103 neural sources unchanged. Seven native initial parities against a separately strict-loaded V187 EMA model, six nonzero trained-head CPU/GPU readouts. Each loss mode starts identical donor weights with fresh Adam/EMA clocks0 and performs two training-only four-image updates(mesh,mixed), with real Model/Adam/EMA/CPU-CUDA RNG restoration after its first update. Check addition output derivatives on CPU and all508 head parameter derivatives against CPU replay of the GPU upstream gradient. Protected GFX inputs are parity-only. All nine earlier terms/masks retained; add.25domain-weight whole or directional response. Probes never initialize future training. No new source/noise,parent/DINO inference,RAW decode or original/dataz access. Localforecast.05GiB above40GiB reserve; no external writes. Old architecture/CPU geometry contracts reused, not counted as new.",
    }
    plan["inputs"] = [dep[k] for k in ["publication", "verification", "CPU_result", "CPU_tests"]]
    plan["inputs"] += [
        plan["donor"]["export"],
        plan["initializer"]["export"],
        plan["sampling_library"],
        plan["pair_units"],
    ]
    for case in plan["cases"]:
        plan["inputs"] += [case["arrays"], case["parent"]]
    plan["frozen_files"] = sources
    resources(plan)
    save(ROOT / "plan-v1.json", plan)
    print("Prepared shared V187 EMA / 7 parities / two modes x two restored updates")


def probe():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan, __file__)
    owner = require_launch(ROOT, "probe")
    (ROOT / "probe.claim").open("x").close()
    try:
        import numpy as np
        import torch
        from coherent_pair_objective import paired_coherent_response_loss
        from directional_pair_objective import objective
        from directional_pair_reference import independent
        from phase_wave_training_state import clocks, fresh_state, inherited_hash, update_ema
        from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
        from spatial_wave_training_state import pack_checkpoint, restore_factored
        from train_coherent_pair_evidence_engine import instrument

        runtime(plan)
        donor = torch.load(plan["donor"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        inherited = plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
        counts = dict.fromkeys(["wrapper", "frozen", "network", "sampler", "projection"], 0)

        def new_model():
            m = factory(plan["module_config"])
            m.load_state_dict(donor["state_dict"], strict=True)
            assert model_hash(m) == plan["donor"]["module_hash"]
            assert inherited_hash(m) == inherited
            return instrument(m.cuda(), counts).train()

        model = new_model()
        baseline = factory(plan["module_config"])
        baseline.load_state_dict(donor["state_dict"], strict=True)
        baseline = instrument(baseline.cuda(), counts).eval().requires_grad_(False)
        parities = []
        for case in plan["cases"]:
            resources(plan)
            with np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as archive:
                batch = {
                    k: torch.from_numpy(archive[k]).cuda()
                    for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]
                }
            base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)).cuda()
            args = [batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]]
            with torch.no_grad():
                old = baseline(base, *args)
                actual, aux = model(base, *args, return_aux=True)
                assert torch.equal(old.view(torch.int32), actual.view(torch.int32))
                row = {
                    "case": case["id"],
                    "native_values": actual.numel(),
                    "V187_EMA_initial_bit_exact": True,
                    "noisy": case["noisy"],
                }
                if aux["wave_evidence_features"] is not None:
                    head = copy.deepcopy(model.wave_readout).cpu()
                    expected = head(
                        aux["wave_evidence_features"].cpu(),
                        aux["wave_selection"]["bin_yx"].cpu(),
                        aux["wave_support_context"].cpu(),
                    )
                    actual_head = model.wave_readout(
                        aux["wave_evidence_features"],
                        aux["wave_selection"]["bin_yx"],
                        aux["wave_support_context"],
                    ).cpu()
                    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_head, expected, **plan["readout_tolerance"])
                    row.update(
                        nonzero_head_values=expected.numel(),
                        CPU_GPU_head_maximum_difference=float((actual_head - expected).abs().max()),
                    )
                    del head, expected, actual_head
            parities.append(row)
            save(ROOT / f"parity-{len(parities)}-v1.json", row)
            print("parity", case["id"], flush=True)
            del batch, base, args, old, actual, aux
            gc.collect()
        del baseline, model
        units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
        all_records, checkpoints, restorations = [], [], []
        for mode in MODES:
            model = new_model()
            optimizer, ema = fresh_state(model, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"])
            assert clocks(model, optimizer) == {"tensors": 4, "states": 0, "steps": []}
            assert all(
                torch.equal(p, ema[n]) for n, p in model.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad
            )
            for update, domain in enumerate(plan["probe_domains"], 1):
                resources(plan)
                case = next(c for c in plan["cases"] if c["domain"] == domain)
                with np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as archive:
                    batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(archive[k]).cuda() for k in archive.files}
                base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)).cuda()
                pair_units = torch.tensor(
                    units[case["training_step"] - 1]["candidate_units_FP32"],
                    device="cuda",
                    dtype=torch.float32,
                ).reshape(-1, 1, 1, 1)
                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                output, aux = model(
                    base,
                    *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]),
                    return_aux=True,
                )
                weight = plan["domain_weights"][domain]
                loss, terms, mask = objective(
                    output, aux["frozen_output"], batch, pair_units, weight, mode=mode
                )
                scalars = {k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()}
                assert float(loss.detach()) == objective_total(scalars, weight)
                addition_grad = (
                    torch.autograd.grad(terms["response_addition"], output, retain_graph=True)[0]
                    .detach()
                    .cpu()
                )
                cpu_value = output.detach().cpu()
                if mode == "directional":
                    expected_loss, expected_grad = independent(
                        cpu_value.double().numpy(),
                        batch["target"].cpu().double().numpy(),
                        batch["pair_indices"].cpu().numpy(),
                        1,
                    )
                    expected_grad = torch.from_numpy(expected_grad).float()
                else:
                    cpu_value.requires_grad_(True)
                    cpu_loss = paired_coherent_response_loss(
                        cpu_value, batch["target"].cpu(), batch["pair_indices"].cpu()
                    )
                    expected_loss = float(cpu_loss.detach())
                    expected_grad = torch.autograd.grad(cpu_loss, cpu_value)[0]
                assert abs(expected_loss - scalars["response_addition"]) < 3e-6
                torch.testing.assert_close(
                    addition_grad, expected_grad, **plan["response_gradient_tolerance"]
                )
                upstream = torch.autograd.grad(loss, output, retain_graph=True)[0].detach().cpu()
                head = copy.deepcopy(model.wave_readout).cpu()
                cpu_correction = (
                    head(
                        aux["wave_evidence_features"].cpu(),
                        aux["wave_selection"]["bin_yx"].cpu(),
                        aux["wave_support_context"].cpu(),
                    )
                    * aux["sigma"].cpu()
                )
                cpu_gradients = torch.autograd.grad(
                    (cpu_correction * upstream).sum(), tuple(head.parameters())
                )
                loss.backward()
                differences, nonzero = [], {}
                for (name, p), expected in zip(
                    model.wave_readout.named_parameters(), cpu_gradients, strict=True
                ):
                    assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                    torch.testing.assert_close(p.grad.cpu(), expected, **plan["gradient_tolerance"])
                    differences.append(float((p.grad.cpu() - expected).abs().max()))
                    nonzero[name] = int(p.grad.count_nonzero())
                    assert nonzero[name] > 0
                assert all(
                    p.grad is None
                    for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                    if not n.startswith("wave_readout.")
                )
                norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                    model.wave_readout.parameters(), 1, error_if_nonfinite=True
                )
                optimizer.step()
                decay = update_ema(model, ema, updates=update)
                assert inherited_hash(model) == inherited
                assert clocks(model, optimizer) == {
                    "tensors": 4,
                    "states": 4,
                    "steps": [float(update)],
                }
                record = {
                    "mode": mode,
                    "update": update,
                    "domain": domain,
                    "case": case["id"],
                    "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                    "terms": scalars,
                    "ten_term_FP32_total_exact": True,
                    "mask_pixels": int(mask.sum()),
                    "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                    "parameter_gradient_coordinates": 508,
                    "nonzero_gradients": nonzero,
                    "CPU_GPU_parameter_gradient_maximum_difference": max(differences),
                    "response_gradient_coordinates": addition_grad.numel(),
                    "response_gradient_maximum_difference": float(
                        (addition_grad - expected_grad).abs().max()
                    ),
                    "independent_response_loss": expected_loss,
                    "EMA_decay": decay,
                    "Adam": clocks(model, optimizer),
                    "module_hash": model_hash(model),
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                }
                all_records.append(record)
                path = ROOT / "artifacts" / f"{mode}-probe-step{update}.pt"
                payload = {
                    "models": model.state_dict(),
                    "ema": ema,
                    "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
                    "updates": update,
                    "mode": mode,
                    "inherited_hash": inherited,
                    "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                    "component": type(model).__name__,
                    "module_config": plan["module_config"],
                    "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "scope": "Probe only; never a training initializer",
                }
                with path.open("xb") as stream:
                    torch.save(pack_checkpoint(payload, plan["initializer"]["export"]), stream)
                checkpoints.append(ref(path))
                save(ROOT / f"{mode}-update-{update}-v1.json", record)
                del (
                    output,
                    aux,
                    loss,
                    terms,
                    mask,
                    batch,
                    base,
                    pair_units,
                    payload,
                    upstream,
                    head,
                    cpu_correction,
                    cpu_gradients,
                )
                del cpu_value, expected_grad, addition_grad
                if mode == "whole":
                    del cpu_loss
                if update == 1:
                    saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                    del model, optimizer
                    gc.collect()
                    model = instrument(factory(plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts).train()
                    optimizer, ema = restore_factored(
                        model, saved, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
                    )
                    assert (
                        model_hash(model) == record["module_hash"]
                        and inherited_hash(model) == inherited
                    )
                    restorations.append(
                        {
                            "mode": mode,
                            "checkpoint": ref(path),
                            "model_Adam_EMA_CPU_CUDA_RNG_exact": True,
                            "repeated_prefix_forwards": 0,
                        }
                    )
                    del saved
                print("update", mode, update, "loss", record["loss"], flush=True)
            del model, optimizer, ema
            gc.collect()
        assert counts == {
            "wrapper": 18,
            "frozen": 18,
            "network": 16,
            "sampler": 80,
            "projection": 16,
        }
        guard(plan, __file__)
        save(
            ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "pass-V195-V187-EMA-parity-both-response-gradients-and-restoration",
                "owner": owner,
                "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                "parities": parities,
                "records": all_records,
                "checkpoints": checkpoints,
                "restorations": restorations,
                "counts": counts,
                "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "inherited189_unchanged": True,
                "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
                "protected_optimizer_inputs": 0,
                "scope": plan["scope"],
            },
        )
        print(
            "PASS: seven shared parities, six head parities, four updates, two restorations",
            flush=True,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        save(
            ROOT / "admission-failure-v1.json",
            {"owner": owner, "error": repr(exc), "time_UTC": time.time()},
        )
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "launch", "probe"])
    phase = parser.parse_args().phase
    if phase == "prepare":
        prepare()
    elif phase == "launch":
        print(launch(ROOT, "probe"))
    else:
        probe()

inspect_directional_admission.py.text:
"""CPU-only inspection of all four terminal V195 probe checkpoints."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from directional_trial_protocol import ADMISSION as ROOT
from directional_trial_protocol import factory, guard, read, ref, save
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live


def inspect(output):
    result = read(ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json")
    assert result["status"] == "pass-V195-V187-EMA-parity-both-response-gradients-and-restoration"
    assert not owner_live(result["owner"])
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    import torch
    from phase_wave_training_state import clocks, fresh_state, inherited_hash, load_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from spatial_wave_training_state import expand_checkpoint
    from train_local_noise_matching_trial import tree_equal

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    inherited = torch.load(
        plan["initializer"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )["state_dict"]
    assert len(inherited) == 189
    original = torch.nn.Module._call_impl

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("CPU inspection cannot perform module forwards")

    torch.nn.Module._call_impl = forbidden
    rows = []
    try:
        for binding, record in zip(result["checkpoints"], result["records"], strict=True):
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            state = expand_checkpoint(
                torch.load(binding["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            )
            assert state["mode"] == record["mode"] and state["updates"] == record["update"]
            module = factory(plan["module_config"])
            module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
            assert len(module.state_dict()) == 193 and model_hash(module) == record["module_hash"]
            raw_hash = model_hash(module)
            optimizer, _ = fresh_state(module, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"])
            optimizer.load_state_dict(state["optimizer"])
            assert tree_equal(optimizer.state_dict(), state["optimizer"])
            assert clocks(module, optimizer) == {
                "tensors": 4,
                "states": 4,
                "steps": [float(record["update"])],
            }
            for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]:
                if endpoint == "EMA":
                    load_ema(module, state["ema"])
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(module.state_dict()[name], value)
                    for name, value in inherited.items()
                )
                assert inherited_hash(module) == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
            rows.append(
                {
                    "checkpoint": binding,
                    "mode": record["mode"],
                    "update": record["update"],
                    "raw_module_hash": raw_hash,
                    "EMA_module_hash": model_hash(module),
                    "Adam": clocks(module, optimizer),
                    "inherited_tensors_each_state": 189,
                }
            )
    finally:
        torch.nn.Module._call_impl = original
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized() and len(rows) == 4
    save(
        output,
        {
            "status": "pass-V195-four-probes-eight-CPU-raw-EMA-loads-and-Adam",
            "admission": ref(ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json"),
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoints": rows,
            "strict_CPU_raw_EMA_loads": 8,
            "inherited_tensor_comparisons": 1512,
            "new_module_forwards": 0,

    print("PASS: four probes / eight raw-EMA loads /1512 inherited checks / no forwards")

"""Matched whole/directional response stages from the identical V187 EMA donor."""

import argparse
import gc
import json
import math
import shutil
import time
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path

from directional_trial_protocol import (
    ADMISSION,
    MODES,
    REPO,
    dependency,
    factory,
    freeze,
    guard,
    launch,
    objective_total,
    read,
    ref,
    require_launch,
    resources,
    save,
)
from directional_trial_protocol import (
    TRIAL as ROOT,
)
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live

ARTIFACTS = ROOT / "artifacts"
METHODS = {
    mode: {endpoint: f"V195-{mode}-response-{endpoint}" for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]}
    for mode in MODES
}


def common_engine():
    import train_coherent_pair_evidence_engine as common

    common.ROOT = ROOT
    return common


def load_donor(config, state):
    module = factory(config)
    module.load_state_dict(state, strict=True)
    return module


def ready():
    result = read(ADMISSION / "admission-result-v1.json")
    assert result["status"].startswith("pass-V195-V187-EMA-parity")
    assert not owner_live(result["owner"])
    inspection = read(ADMISSION / "CPU-inspection-v1.json")
    assert inspection["status"] == "pass-V195-four-probes-eight-CPU-raw-EMA-loads-and-Adam"
    assert inspection["admission"] == ref(ADMISSION / "admission-result-v1.json")


def prepare():
    dep = dependency()
    ready()
    assert not ROOT.exists()
    baseline = read(dep["V187_plan"]["path"])
    import torch
    from phase_wave_training_state import clocks, fresh_state, inherited_hash
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    donor = torch.load(dep["donor"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = load_donor(dep["donor"]["module_config"], donor["state_dict"])
    optimizer, ema = fresh_state(module, lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.01)
    assert model_hash(module) == dep["donor"]["module_hash"]
    assert inherited_hash(module) == dep["initializer"]["module_hash"]
    assert clocks(module, optimizer) == {"tensors": 4, "states": 0, "steps": []}
    assert all(torch.equal(p, ema[n]) for n, p in module.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    assert module.wave_readout.mixing.weight.count_nonzero() > 0
    assert sum(p.numel() for p in module.parameters() if p.requires_grad) == 508
    proof = {
        "full_module_hash": model_hash(module),
        "inherited_hash": inherited_hash(module),
        "fresh_Adam": clocks(module, optimizer),
        "EMA_equals_trained_donor_head": True,
        "head_parameters": 508,
        "head_tensors": 4,
        "strict_full_state_tensors": 193,
        "head_final_weights_nonzero": True,
        "CPU_only_no_forward": True,
    }
    ROOT.mkdir()
    for mode in MODES:
        (ARTIFACTS / mode / "checkpoints").mkdir(parents=True)
    (ARTIFACTS / "native").mkdir()
    work, sources = freeze(ROOT, ["train_directional_response.py", "audit_directional_training.py"])
    plan = {
        k: baseline[k]
        for k in [
            "cache",
            "pair_units",
            "training_provenance",
            "frozen_component",
            "design",
            "prior_scores",
            "metrics_sources",
            "native_cases",
            "processing_order",
            "sampling_library",
            "domain_weights",
            "steps",
            "warmup",
            "gradient_clip",
            "CUDA_quota_GiB",
            "launch_RAM_GiB",
        ]
    }
    plan.update(
        status="prepared-matched-response-head-training-from-completed-V187-EMA",
        created_unix_UTC=time.time(),
        root=str(ROOT),
        work=str(work),
        artifacts=str(ARTIFACTS),
        runner=ref(work / "scripts/train_directional_response.py"),
        auditor=ref(work / "scripts/audit_directional_training.py"),
        seed=202611080195,
        modes=list(MODES),
        methods=METHODS,
        module_config=dep["donor"]["module_config"],
        donor=dep["donor"],
        initializer=dep["initializer"],
        dependency=dep,
        CPU_initialization=proof,
        lr=0.001,
        weight_decay=0.01,
        EMA_decay=0.999,
        head_initial_updates=0,
        prior_donor_head_updates=900,
        inherited_network_updates=1800,
        inherited_adapter_updates=900,
        minimum_GiB={"local": 40, "RAM": 32},
        total_new_local_forecast_GiB=2.0,
        total_new_external_forecast_GiB=0,
        admission=ref(ADMISSION / "admission-result-v1.json"),
        admission_inspection=ref(ADMISSION / "CPU-inspection-v1.json"),
        V187_plan=dep["V187_plan"],
        V187_scores=ref(Path(dep["V187_plan"]["path"]).parent / "scores-v1.json"),
        baseline_plan=baseline["baseline_plan"],
        baseline_scores=baseline["baseline_scores"],
        loss_source=ref(work / "scripts/directional_pair_objective.py"),
        expected_training_counts_per_arm={
            "wrapper": 900,
            "frozen": 900,
            "network": 900,
            "sampler": 4500,
            "projection": 900,
        },
        expected_quality_counts={
            "wrapper": 3288,
            "frozen": 3288,
            "network": 3000,
            "sampler": 15000,
            "projection": 3000,
        },
        storage_scope="Reuse immutable datasets, cached parents, manifests and baseline native encodings without copying them. Selective code import closure only. Total new local budget2GiB covers four endpoints' native RGB+wave encodings(uncompressed worst<1GiB),ten factored checkpoints,four strict exports,compressed receipts,compact current-comparator figures/browser captures and Git. No regeneration or recopy of all historical panels. No external writes. Check local40/RAM32 before every forward; launchRAM52/CUDAquota24.",
        scope="Matched whole versus directional response pressure. Both start the same completed V187 EMA full193state, trained508parameter head and fresh identical head Adam/EMA clocks0;189 inherited V183 EMA tensors remain frozen. Each uses the same1000 cached rows,900 noisy updates,3600 images,100 ADC skips,five checkpoints and genuine row8restore with no prefix replay. Nine old terms/masks,loss order,domain weights,LR,schedule,clip,EMA unchanged. Add.25domain-weight whole response(control,totalwhole.50)or eight-region response(directional,oldwhole.25). Equal added weights do not imply equal gradient norms. This is a new matched retraining stage,not resumed old Adam history. Probe checkpoints forbidden as initializers. Both states of both arms require all822quality cases,quiet/absent/fresh flats,natural detail and both protected GFX families with native100percent triplets. All103 neural sources unchanged. Cached scenes/JPEGs/siblings remain heldout; real references are qualitative,not exact GT. No new source/noise draw,parent/DINO inference,RAW decode or original/dataz access. No quality claim at launch.",
    )
    plan["inputs"] = [
        plan[k]
        for k in [
            "cache",
            "pair_units",
            "training_provenance",
            "design",
            "prior_scores",
            "sampling_library",
            "admission",
            "admission_inspection",
            "V187_plan",
            "V187_scores",
            "baseline_plan",
            "baseline_scores",
        ]
    ]
    plan["inputs"] += plan["metrics_sources"] + [
        dep[k] for k in ["publication", "verification", "CPU_result", "CPU_tests"]
    ]
    plan["inputs"] += [dep["donor"]["export"], dep["initializer"]["export"]]
    plan["frozen_files"] = sources
    resources(plan)
    assert shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > (40 + 2) * 2**30
    save(ROOT / "plan-v1.json", plan)
    print(
        "Prepared matched arms from V187 EMA; 2x900 updates; fresh head clocks0; local budget2GiB"
    )


def train(mode):
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan, __file__)
    common = common_engine()
    owner = require_launch(ROOT, mode)
    (ROOT / f"{mode}-train.claim").open("x").close()
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from directional_pair_objective import objective as objective_impl

    objective = partial(objective_impl, mode=mode)
    from phase_wave_training_state import (
        clocks,
        fresh_state,
        inherited_hash,
        readout_parameters,
        update_ema,
    )
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from spatial_wave_training_state import pack_checkpoint, restore_factored

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    common.runtime(plan)
    torch.manual_seed(plan["seed"])
    counts = dict.fromkeys(["wrapper", "frozen", "network", "sampler", "projection"], 0)
    initial = torch.load(plan["donor"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = common.instrument(
        load_donor(plan["module_config"], initial["state_dict"]).cuda(),
        counts,
    ).train()
    assert model_hash(module) == plan["donor"]["module_hash"]
    del initial
    optimizer, ema = fresh_state(module, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"])
    inherited = plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
    assert inherited_hash(module) == inherited
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    save(
        ROOT / f"{mode}-initial-state-v1.json",
        {
            "mode": mode,
            "donor": plan["donor"]["export"],
            "module_hash": model_hash(module),
            "inherited_hash": inherited,
            "Adam": clocks(module, optimizer),
            "EMA_equals_donor_head": all(
                torch.equal(p, ema[n]) for n, p in module.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad
            ),
            "CPU_RNG": fingerprint(cpu_rng.numpy()),
            "CUDA_RNG": fingerprint(cuda_rng.cpu().numpy()),
            "seed": plan["seed"],
            "new_module_forwards": 0,
        },
    )
    rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
    updates = skipped = images = 0
    trace = []
    checkpoints = []
    restoration = None
    maxima = {n: 0.0 for n in readout_parameters(module)}
    with (ROOT / f"{mode}-train-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x") as journal:
        for step, item in enumerate(rows, 1):
            common.resources(plan, mode, owner)
            assert (
                ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
                and ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
            )
            arrays = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
            parent = np.load(item["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} == item["inputs"] and fingerprint(
                parent
            ) == item["parent_values"]
            assert units[step - 1]["step"] == step and units[step - 1]["batch"] == item["arrays"]
            phase = max(0, step - plan["warmup"]) / (plan["steps"] - plan["warmup"])
            lr = (
                plan["lr"]
                * min(1, step / plan["warmup"])
                * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * phase)) / 2)
            )
            row = {
                "step": step,
                "batch": item["arrays"],
                "parent": item["parent"],
                "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
                "noisy": bool(np.any(arrays["variance"] > 0)),
                "lr": lr,
            }
            if row["noisy"]:
                batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in arrays.items()}
                base = torch.from_numpy(parent).cuda()
                pair_units = torch.tensor(
                    units[step - 1]["candidate_units_FP32"], device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32
                ).reshape(-1, 1, 1, 1)
                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                    group["lr"] = lr
                output, aux = module(
                    base,
                    *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]),
                    return_aux=True,
                )
                loss, terms, mask = objective(
                    output,
                    aux["frozen_output"],
                    batch,
                    pair_units,
                    plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]],
                )
                assert torch.isfinite(loss)
                loss.backward()
                zero = []
                for name, p in readout_parameters(module).items():
                    assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all(), name
                    maxima[name] = max(maxima[name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
                    if p.grad.count_nonzero() == 0:
                        zero.append(name)
                assert all(
                    p.grad is None
                    for n, p in module.named_parameters()
                    if not n.startswith("wave_readout.")
                )
                norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                    readout_parameters(module).values(),
                    plan["gradient_clip"],
                    error_if_nonfinite=True,
                )
                optimizer.step()
                updates += 1
                images += len(base)
                decay = update_ema(module, ema, updates=updates)
                row.update(
                    loss=float(loss.detach()),
                    terms={k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()},
                    gradient_norm=float(norm),
                    zero_gradient_tensors=zero,
                    flat_mask=fingerprint(mask.cpu().numpy()),
                    flat_eligible_pixels=int(mask.sum()),
                    wave_RMS_DN16=float(aux["wave_correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt())
                    * 65535,
                    EMA_decay=decay,
                )
                assert row["loss"] == objective_total(
                    row["terms"], plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]]
                )
                del batch, base, pair_units, output, aux, loss, terms, mask
            else:
                skipped += 1
                row["skipped"] = "zero variance;no matching,readout or optimizer call"
            row.update(updates=updates, counts=dict(counts))
            trace.append(row)
            journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            journal.flush()
            if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
                common.progress(
                    mode,
                    {
                        "status": "training",
                        "owner": owner,
                        "step": step,
                        "updates": updates,
                        "counts": dict(counts),
                        "peak_CUDA_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                    },
                )
            if step in [8, 250, 500, 750, 1000]:
                assert inherited_hash(module) == inherited and clocks(module, optimizer) == {
                    "tensors": 4,
                    "states": 4,
                    "steps": [float(updates)],
                }
                path = ARTIFACTS / mode / "checkpoints" / f"wave-step{step:04d}.pt"
                payload = {
                    "models": module.state_dict(),
                    "mode": mode,
                    "ema": ema,
                    "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
                    "step": step,
                    "updates": updates,
                    "inherited_hash": inherited,
                    "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "component": type(module).__name__,
                    "module_config": plan["module_config"],
                    "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                }
                with path.open("xb") as stream:
                    torch.save(pack_checkpoint(payload, plan["initializer"]["export"]), stream)
                checkpoints.append(ref(path))
                del payload
                if step == 8:
                    before = model_hash(module)
                    saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                    del module, optimizer
                    gc.collect()
                    module = common.instrument(
                        factory(plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts
                    ).train()
                    optimizer, ema = restore_factored(
                        module, saved, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
                    )
                    assert model_hash(module) == before and inherited_hash(module) == inherited
                    restoration = {
                        "checkpoint": ref(path),
                        "model_Adam_EMA_CPU_CUDA_RNG_exact": True,
                        "continued_at_row": 9,
                        "repeated_prefix_forwards": 0,
                    }
                    save(ROOT / f"{mode}-restoration-v1.json", restoration)
                    del saved
            del arrays, parent
    assert len(trace) == 1000 and updates == 900 and skipped == 100 and images == 3600
    assert counts == {
        "wrapper": 900,
        "frozen": 900,
        "network": 900,
        "sampler": 4500,
        "projection": 900,
    }
    assert inherited_hash(module) == inherited and all(v > 0 for v in maxima.values())
    assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    guard(plan, __file__)
    save(
        ROOT / f"{mode}-train-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-V195-matched-response-head-from-V187-EMA",
            "mode": mode,
            "donor": plan["donor"]["export"],
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "trace": trace,
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "final_checkpoint": checkpoints[-1],
            "updates": updates,
            "ADC_skips": skipped,
            "training_images": images,
            "counts": counts,
            "final_Adam": clocks(module, optimizer),
            "inherited189_tensors_unchanged": True,
            "inherited_hash": inherited,
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "restoration": restoration,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maxima,
            "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    common.progress(
        mode,
        {
            "status": "completed-training",
            "owner": owner,
            "step": 1000,
            "updates": 900,
            "counts": counts,
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "launch", "train"])
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=MODES)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.phase == "prepare":
        prepare()
    else:
        assert args.mode in MODES
        ready()
        if args.phase == "launch":
            print(launch(ROOT, "train", mode=args.mode))
        else:
            try:
                train(args.mode)
            except BaseException as exc:
                save(
                    ROOT / f"{args.mode}-train-failure-v1.json",
                    {"error": repr(exc), "time_UTC": time.time()},
                )
                raise

"""Independent V195 matched trace, initialization and ten-checkpoint CPU audit."""

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from directional_trial_protocol import (
    MODES,
    factory,
    guard,
    read,
    ref,
    save,
)
from directional_trial_protocol import (
    TRIAL as ROOT,
)
from directional_trial_protocol import (
    objective_total as loss_from_terms,
)
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live


def validate_trace(trace, cache, units, old_trace, plan):
    assert len(trace) == len(cache) == len(units) == len(old_trace) == plan["steps"]
    updates = skips = images = 0
    counts = dict.fromkeys(["wrapper", "frozen", "network", "sampler", "projection"], 0)
    for step, (row, item, unit, old) in enumerate(
        zip(trace, cache, units, old_trace, strict=True), 1
    ):
        assert row["step"] == item["step"] == unit["step"] == old["step"] == step
        assert row["batch"] == item["arrays"] == unit["batch"] == old["batch"]
        assert row["parent"] == item["parent"] == old["parent"]
        assert row["domain"] == item["metadata"]["domain"] == old["domain"]
        assert type(row["noisy"]) is bool and row["noisy"] == old["noisy"]
        p = max(0, step - plan["warmup"]) / (plan["steps"] - plan["warmup"])
        lr = (
            plan["lr"]
            * min(1, step / plan["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * p)) / 2)
        )
        assert row["lr"] == lr
        if row["noisy"]:
            updates += 1
            images += item["inputs"]["packed"]["shape"][0]
            assert row["loss"] == loss_from_terms(
                row["terms"], plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]]
            )
            assert (
                row["flat_mask"] == old["flat_mask"]
                and row["flat_eligible_pixels"] == old["flat_eligible_pixels"]
            )
            assert row["EMA_decay"] == min(0.999, (1 + updates) / (10 + updates))
            assert math.isfinite(row["gradient_norm"]) and row["gradient_norm"] >= 0
            assert math.isfinite(row["wave_RMS_DN16"]) and row["wave_RMS_DN16"] >= 0
            assert set(row["zero_gradient_tensors"]) <= {
                f"wave_readout.{p}.{s}" for p in ["context", "mixing"] for s in ["weight", "bias"]
            }
        else:
            skips += 1
            assert row["skipped"] == "zero variance;no matching,readout or optimizer call"
            assert "loss" not in row and "terms" not in row
        counts = {k: (5 * updates if k == "sampler" else updates) for k in counts}
        assert row["counts"] == counts and row["updates"] == updates
    return {
        "rows": len(trace),
        "FP32_ten_term_totals": updates,
        "clean_masks": updates,
        "updates": updates,
        "ADC_skips": skips,
        "images": images,
        "counts": counts,
    }


def terminal(mode):
    launch = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-launch-v1.json")
    assert not owner_live(launch["owner"])
    assert not (ROOT / f"{mode}-train-failure-v1.json").exists()
    result = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-train-result-v1.json")
    assert result["status"] == "completed-V195-matched-response-head-from-V187-EMA"
    assert result["owner"] == launch["owner"] and result["mode"] == mode
    return result


def audit():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["auditor"]
    results = {mode: terminal(mode) for mode in MODES}
    import torch
    from phase_wave_training_state import clocks, inherited_hash, load_ema, restore_state
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from spatial_wave_training_state import expand_checkpoint
    from train_local_noise_matching_trial import tree_equal

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    initial = torch.load(
        plan["initializer"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )["state_dict"]
    donor = torch.load(plan["donor"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)[
        "state_dict"
    ]
    module = factory(plan["module_config"])
    module.load_state_dict(donor, strict=True)
    assert (
        model_hash(module)
        == plan["CPU_initialization"]["full_module_hash"]
        == plan["donor"]["module_hash"]
    )
    cache = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
    old = read(Path(plan["V187_plan"]["path"]).parent / "wave-train-result-v1.json")["trace"]
    traces, starts, checks, saved = {}, {}, {}, []
    for mode in MODES:
        result = results[mode]
        assert (
            result["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
            and result["donor"] == plan["donor"]["export"]
        )
        starts[mode] = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-initial-state-v1.json")
        start = starts[mode]
        assert (
            start["module_hash"] == plan["donor"]["module_hash"] and start["EMA_equals_donor_head"]
        )
        assert start["Adam"] == {"tensors": 4, "states": 0, "steps": []}
        assert start["inherited_hash"] == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
        path = ROOT / f"{mode}-train-trace-v1.jsonl"
        traces[mode] = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
        assert traces[mode] == result["trace"]
        checks[mode] = validate_trace(traces[mode], cache, units, old, plan)
        assert checks[mode]["updates"] == result["updates"] == 900
        assert result["counts"] == plan["expected_training_counts_per_arm"]
        assert result["training_images"] == 3600 and result["ADC_skips"] == 100
        assert result["RNG_unchanged"] and result["inherited189_tensors_unchanged"]
        restoration = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-restoration-v1.json")
        assert (
            restoration == result["restoration"]
